subject: indiv-td
title: (R)INDIV.TD.------SOC.RT.
description: Chart 1 of 2 on book p. 53 (BK(NM)-29). INDIV-TD (individual tendencies) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; SOC-RT (social reality) is the partner. From the subject: PHY-U-P (physical universe particular), COS-PP and T-C-IMP (time continuum implications). From PHY-U-P: INFO-DY (information dynamics). From COS-PP: A-PR (all-purpose) and AF-DY (affinity dynamics). From INFO-DY: INFO-DS (information dissemination). From INFO-DS: ATTN (attraction), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From ATTN: PROG-CONT (progressional continuance).
